defense_news.title: It’s official: US Army’s improved M8 rifle to begin fielding in December
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army will begin fielding Sig Sauer’s M8 rifle in December, replacing the M7 with a lighter, shorter carbine based on soldier feedback.

defense_news.title: Pentagon names 4 directed-energy weapons for counter-drone program at US bases
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon named four directed energy weapons for a homeland counter-drone program, the first systems to be fielded and tested at U.S. bases.

defense_news.title: France fires upgraded nuclear-capable missile from submarine for first time
defense_news.summary: France test-fired an upgraded version of its M51 strategic ballistic missile from a submarine for the first time on Tuesday.

defense_news.title: Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A CCA completes first fully autonomous flight
defense_news.summary: The successful flight came just weeks after U.S. Air Force officials announced their intention to have 500 autonomous aircraft in service by 2032.

geo_news.title: Ankara'da yarın bazı yollar araç trafiğine kapatılacak
geo_news.summary: Başkentte, Filistin'e destek amacıyla düzenlenecek yürüyüş nedeniyle yarın bazı yolların araç trafiğine kapatılacağı bildirildi.

geo_news.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, Filistinli Hind Rajab'ın ailesini kabul etti
geo_news.summary: Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, Gazze'de İsrail'in saldırısı sonucu bir araçta mahsur kalarak hayatını kaybeden 6 yaşındaki Filistinli Hind Rajab'ın ailesini kabul etti.
